trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: User requests a refund for their booking and provides their lead ID.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मला माझा booking amount refund हवा आहे. मी काही महिन्यांपूर्वी पैसे भरले होते. माझा lead ID LD-2002 आहे.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the user's request and state the intention to look up the booking details.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should politely acknowledge the request and transition to looking up the booking.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी तुमची नक्की मदत करेन. मी तुमचा lead ID system मध्ये check करतो. एक मिनिट द्या.
steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the user's request and state the intention to look up the booking details using the provided lead ID.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details using the provided lead ID.
Return booking details.
Share the booking reference and ask for a verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should state the booking reference and prompt the user for a verification factor.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. मला तुमचा booking reference BK-9002 दिसत आहे. पुढे जाण्याआधी, security साठी तुमचे registered name सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Share the booking reference retrieved from the system and ask for the registered name to verify identity before proceeding.

steps.purpose: User provides their registered name, but the STT mishears it.
Verify customer identity using the registered name factor.
Return identity verification failure due to STT error on the name.
Inform the user of the verification failure and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should handle the verification failure gracefully and ask for another factor without revealing sensitive info.
steps.text: माफ करा, हे नाव system मध्ये match होत नाहीये. तुमची date of birth, म्हणजे जन्म तारीख सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user that the first verification factor failed and request an alternative factor, date of birth.

steps.purpose: User confirms the meaning of the domain term and provides their date of birth.
steps.text: Date of birth म्हणजे माझी जन्म तारीख ना? हो, ती 12 May 1985 आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the date of birth factor.
Return identity verification success.
Acknowledge successful verification, state the amount paid, and announce eligibility check.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should acknowledge verification success, ground the amount paid in the tool result, and transition to checking eligibility.
steps.text: धन्यवाद, तुमची माहिती verify झाली आहे. तुम्ही 500000 rupees pay केले होते. मी तुमची refund eligibility check करतो.
steps.planner_rationale: Confirm successful verification, state the amount paid to build trust, and announce the intention to check refund eligibility.

steps.purpose: Check if the booking is eligible for a refund.
Return refund eligibility details indicating no refund is possible.
Explain the unrefundable status based on the tool results.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must state the unrefundable status, the zero amount, and the reason exactly as provided by the tools, without making any promises.
steps.text: मी check केलं आहे. तुमचा allotment 'confirmed' झाला आहे, आणि payment ला 140 दिवस झाले आहेत. Agreement च्या rules नुसार, हे booking amount refundable नाहीये, म्हणून तुम्हाला 0 rupees मिळणार आहेत.
steps.planner_rationale: Explain that the booking is not refundable because the allotment is confirmed and 140 days have passed, strictly following the tool output.

steps.purpose: User repeats the agent's statement to confirm their understanding of the zero refund.
steps.text: Refundable नाहीये? म्हणजे मला माझे पैसे परत मिळणार नाहीत असंच ना? काही पण deduction करून थोडे पैसे मिळतील का?

steps.purpose: Reiterate the zero refund and deduction amount clearly.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should confirm the user's understanding and restate the deduction and refund amounts accurately.
steps.text: हो, ते बरोबर आहे. तुमचा allotment confirm झाल्यामुळे, cancellation agreement च्या terms नुसार होतो. त्यावेळी booking amount परत मिळत नाही, म्हणून deduction 500000 rupees आहे आणि refund amount zero आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: Reiterate the deduction and zero refund amount to clarify the user's doubt, ensuring all figures match the eligibility result.

steps.purpose: User summarizes their understanding in plain words.
steps.text: अच्छा. म्हणजे allotment confirm झाला की पैसे बुडाले. ठीक आहे, मला समजलं.

steps.purpose: Validate the user's understanding and offer further assistance.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should validate the user's conclusion and politely ask if anything else is needed.
steps.text: हो, agreement नुसार ते तसंच आहे. तुम्हाला या बद्दल अजून काही माहिती हवी आहे का?
steps.planner_rationale: Confirm the user's final understanding and offer any further assistance before closing the call.

steps.purpose: User declines further help and ends the conversation.
steps.text: नाही, एवढंच विचारायचं होतं. ठेवतो मी.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told why the booking is not refundable and on what terms.
